name: Aoqin Dragon Uses Document Lures and USB Shortcut Techniques to Infect Targets
description:
Aoqin Dragon has operated since 2013 targeting government, education, and telecommunication organizations in Southeast Asia and Australia. The threat actor uses document lures with pornographic themes and USB shortcut techniques to spread the malware and infect additional targets.

Infection chain
The threat actor uses a document exploit and tricks the user into opening a weaponized Word document to install a backdoor. The infection lures users into double-clicking a fake anti-virus to execute malware in the victim’s host. It forges a fake removable device to lure users into opening the wrong folder and installing the malware successfully on their system.
